newsitem.title: USA: Becton says currency translation hurt revs.
newsitem.headline: Becton says currency translation hurt revs.

text.p: Becton Dickinson and Co said on Monday that foreign currency translation reduced its revenues by $23 million for the third quarter ending June 30.
Becton said in a news release that its third quarter revenues were $707 million, compared to $693 million for the same period a year ago.
Earnings per share were $0.54, including an $0.11 per share acquisitions charge, compared to $0.58 for the year-ago period.
Becton said its revenues were up five percent, adjusted for currency translation.
Diagnostic systems revenues for the quarter were up two percent to $323 million, while medical supplies and devices revenues rose two percent to $384 million.
